title: Order the open findings into an upgrade plan
prompt: Check unpatched.yml and give me an upgrade plan: what to do first, and which version to move to for each item. Do not make up versions. If no fixed version is known, say so.

files.unpatched.yml:
version: 1
stack:
  - product: linux-kernel
    version: 6.6.20
    name: Backup server
  - product: fortios
    version: 7.2.5
    exposure: internet
    name: Office firewall

reference.answer.md:
1. Office firewall (FortiOS 7.2.5, internet-facing): CVE-2024-21762 is exploited (CISA KEV). Upgrade to 7.2.7 or later today.
2. Backup server (Linux kernel 6.6.20): CVE-2024-26925 affects it, low urgency. No fixed version is named in the data, so check your distribution's advisory and plan it with the next kernel update.
